Name: Kantrip's Older Sam - NPC and Family Expansion
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[size=4]What happens when you follow your dreams, only to fall flat on your face? What if you had your one big shot... and blew it?[/size]

[center][b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]What happens next?[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[left]Sam moved to Pelican Town four years ago to help his mom and little brother while his father went off to serve in war. Sam does everything he can to hold the family together. He works at Joja Mart to earn some extra coin. He smiles as Miss Penny, to make his mom happy. He watches Vincent and helps him with his homework. He does his very best to stay grounded in the present because his past his full of ghosts, and the future? [/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Sam already lost his future.[/left]

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]OVERVIEW:[/size][/color][/b]
Kantrip's Older Sam is an expansion mod, not just for SDV's vanilla character but for his entire family. Follow along as Jodi tries to process her feelings of loneliness and isolation while Kent is gone. Watch Vincent struggle with reading and try to find a way to help him. See Sam smile and wonder if all of that good humor is genuine or just a mask worn to cover something deeper. And see what war makes of a man who served his country but missed out on the most pivotal and precious moments with his family.

[b]This mod includes some darker themes[/b], mostly revolving around Kent's PTSD. You can disable ALL of the more serious events (labeled "black events") with a configuration change, and the mod will provide alternative versions for every single one. There is no right or wrong way to play this mod -- you choose how the story goes. You could easily play this mod through twice and see different events each time.

[b]This is not an 18+ or NSFW (explicit) mod. [/b]While there is some mildly suggestive content in Sam's marriage dialogue, it can be turned off with the "clean marriage dialogue" setting. I also added a swear filter toggle, in case you want to turn off the (mild) cursing that pops up in Sam's dialogue (he is an ex military brat, after all).

[b][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]MOTIVATION:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]I really wanted to see if I could make Sam into a character that I (an older player) felt comfortable romancing. A lot of Sam's original character reads way too young to me -- calling Harvey "Uncle Doctor", saying that he doesn't know how to cook and barely cleans up after himself, acting like a bit of a man child after marriage, etc. Older Sam still has a lot of golden retriever energy, but he also helps Jodi cook dinner, takes turns watching over Vincent and assisting with the homework, holds down a steady job (that he keeps after marriage) and is handy around the house.[/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=5][b]LORE CHANGES:[/b][/size][/color]
Nothing huge. Aside from the age change, Sam keeps the same family relationships and basic history that he already had. I did give him and Jodi a backstory more in line with being a military family (moving base to base, following Kent from deployment to deployment). Older Sam also has different friends (he doesn't hang out with Abby or vanilla Seb, but *does* take walks up to the mountain to visit Linus, and will hang out with Older Seb eventually if you have that mod installed).
